# XVB Playlists

Automatically generated Rakuten TV Italy live-channel playlist.

## Generated files

- [Rakuten Italy M3U](output/rakuten_it.m3u)
- [Rakuten Italy JSON](output/rakuten_it.json)

The GitHub Actions workflow updates these files every day at 04:30 UTC. It can also be started manually from the **Actions** tab.

The generator retrieves live channels, categories, logos and stream URLs from Rakuten TV's public web API. Streams may vary by region and can change or expire.

**EPG is not included yet.** The official Rakuten EPG endpoint has not been identified; no third-party guide is substituted.
